decisions.reason: The request to demonstrate working speed adjustment does not change the existing speed range or operating constraints, and simultaneous operation does not entail simultaneous speed adjustment.

Continuous operation for several minutes is already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, while the separate simultaneous-operation clause does not necessarily require both stations to run simultaneously for that entire duration.
Simultaneous station operation does not change the established splash-control behavior or methods.
The source decision does not address whisk detachment, tool-free removal, cleaning, or swapping.
The simultaneous-operation requirement does not alter whisk size, material, style, compatibility, or positioning.
The source asks for simultaneous station operation but establishes no new smoothness, foam, texture, or high-speed mixing-quality criterion.
Dispensing through both spouts concerns dual-spout operation, not the candidate's flow smoothness, sputtering, consistency, or froth-preservation attributes.
The functional demonstration requirements do not resume or modify the deferred accent-lighting requirement.
Simultaneous station operation does not change bowl capacity, form, size, or refill preferences.
The source acknowledges sturdiness but does not change the existing structural-stability or vibration-control criteria.
The existing power-capacity requirement already covers both motors and related components operating under load, so simultaneous station operation adds no new power-system state.
The source decision concerns functional operation and does not resume or modify the deferred DJ-style decorative details.
